text:
I love the dry techno sound of Commodore 64 SID tunes for deep work, but realized I like them even better with a custom effects/mastering chain, and there was no existing online place to get that.

And given the times, I also added dystopian ads and DJ banter from planet Zomrog to set the right vibe.

So basically a 24/7 wordless web radio station that plays very obscure techno and is also a kind of long-form radio play
title: Show HN: Radio Dystopia
